versions.content: In case o f processing an NvM_WriteAll multi block request, the function NvM_MainFunction shall not call callback routines to the upper layer as long as the service MemIf_GetStatus returns MEMIF_BUSY_INTERNAL for the reserved device ID MEMIF_BROADCAST_ID [7] . For this purpose (status is MEMIF_BUSY_INTERNAL), the function NvM_MainFunction shall cyclically poll the status of the Memory Hardware Abstraction independent of being configured for polling or callback mode.
